rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for sexual desire or libido.

example.english: Their lust has been stronger lately.
example.jyutping: keoi5 zeoi3 gan6 sing3 juk6 bei2 gaau3 koeng4

rows.note: Use this for more intense, morally charged, or explicitly lustful sexual desire rather than the neutral sense.

example.english: This film portrays human lust very explicitly.
example.traditional: 呢套電影將人嘅色慾描寫得好露骨。
